The Lattice & Spire platform

Six connected capabilities. One data model. Built for the operational realities of industrial supply chains.

Lattice & Spire replaces the patchwork of supplier portals, risk subscriptions, contract folders, and forecasting spreadsheets that industrial companies have accumulated over decades. Everything runs on a single graph of suppliers, parts, and contracts — connected to the ERPs you already operate.

Request a demo See capabilities
How it works

From signed contract to first insight in under ten weeks.

The Lattice & Spire deployment model is sequenced specifically for industrials with multiple ERPs, distributed plants, and decades of accumulated supplier data.

step 01 — connect

Connect

Ingest from SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Coupa, your CMMS, and any spreadsheet still running the business. Average time to first sync: 11 days.

step 02 — resolve

Resolve

The entity-resolution engine collapses duplicate supplier records and cross-references part numbers across systems, plants, and acquired entities.

step 03 — enrich

Enrich

Layer in third-party financial health, geopolitical exposure, ESG signals, and parts-cross-reference data — refreshed continuously.

step 04 — operate

Operate

Roll out workspaces for procurement, operations, and finance. Workflows route to the right desk, with audit-grade evidence behind every decision.

Platform capabilities

Six modules. One connected data layer.

Each module is independently licensable, but they share a single graph of suppliers, parts, contracts, and shipments — so insights compound across the platform.

supplier-360
Visibility · Master data

Supplier 360

A unified master record for every supplier, deduplicated across plants, acquired entities, and ERPs. The single source of truth procurement, operations, and finance share.

  • Entity-resolution across multi-ERP environments
  • Configurable scorecards by category and plant
  • Tier-1 to tier-3 dependency mapping
  • Onboarding workflows with KYS controls
  • Bidirectional sync to SAP MDG, Oracle, Coupa
risk-radar
Risk · Continuous monitoring

Risk Radar

Continuous monitoring across geopolitical, financial, climate, and ESG signal classes. Risk Radar flags exposure 6–14 weeks before disruption typically reaches the line.

  • 184 country coverage, 18 signal classes
  • Configurable alerting by category and plant
  • Impact-assessment workflow with mitigation routing
  • Native integration with ServiceNow & Jira
  • Tier-2 and tier-3 event detection
contract-vault
Intelligence · Contracts

Contract Vault

AI parses every MSA, addendum, SOW, and rebate clause across your contract estate — turning paper into structured obligations you can actually operationalize.

  • Clause extraction across 42 contract types
  • Obligation calendar with owner routing
  • Rebate & tier-discount realization tracking
  • Renewal-pipeline dashboard with negotiation prompts
  • Native sync to DocuSign CLM & Ironclad
forecast-engine
Intelligence · Forecasting

Forecast Engine

Demand and leadtime forecasting that blends history, supplier performance, and external signals. Every forecast number is traceable to its source inputs.

  • SKU- and part-level demand forecasting
  • Supplier-leadtime probability distributions
  • Scenario planner for tariff and disruption events
  • S&OP integration with Kinaxis & o9
  • Explainable lineage on every prediction
network-graph
Visibility · N-tier mapping

Network Graph

Map your real supplier network — including the tier-2 and tier-3 dependencies that aren't in any of your ERPs — and overlay risk and spend exposure.

  • Multi-tier supplier discovery via shipping & customs data
  • Critical-path detection across the network
  • Concentration analysis by region, port, sub-supplier
  • Public-data enrichment from 90+ trade datasets
  • Exportable network maps for board reporting
insights-hub
Intelligence · Analytics

Insights Hub

Roles-based analytics across spend, performance, contracts, and risk — with anonymous benchmarks against industrial peers in your category and region.

  • Category spend & savings analytics
  • Anonymous peer benchmarks (categories, regions)
  • Drag-and-drop dashboard builder
  • Scheduled exports to Power BI, Tableau, Snowflake
  • Auditor-ready evidence trail on every metric
Built for scale

The platform IT and security teams will actually sign off on.
